name: Zone Control
author: Sanctuary Mods
description: Supreme Commander's Zone Control, for the converted Zone Control for FAF 8P V2 map. No commanders and no building: every zone you hold sends you units. Destroy a zone's turret, then hold the zone to take it; lose every zone and you're out. Kills earn money and levels: better units, heroes and base artillery, and a shop for attack and defence upgrades and kamikazes. Money and levels need a Mod API with kill credit.

options.label: Seconds between spawns
options.description: Every zone you hold sends you a unit this often (less often at level 2 and up).

options.label: Unit cap per player
options.description: Zones stop sending you units while you have this many.

options.label: Insanity mode
options.description: Levels come after a handful of kills instead of hundreds.
